responsibility: This file implements the out-of-line construction logic for rtx_vector_builder, GCC’s helper for creating CONST_VECTOR RTL constants from sequences or stepped patterns of scalar RTX elements. It finalizes the chosen pattern encoding, recognizes globally cached all-zero/all-one/all-minus-one vectors where possible, materializes rtvec payloads, and constructs CONST_VECTOR nodes with their NPATTERNS and NELTS_PER_PATTERN metadata.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line build logic for rtx_vector_builder, turning the state described in rtx-vector-builder.h into CONST_VECTOR RTL and recognizing cached all-zero/all-one/all-minus-one vectors.
